instagram.creative_rules: Save-worthy educational card. Clean numbered steps. Bold topic headline. Consistent color palette.

pinterest.creative_rules: Vertical infographic. Step-by-step guide. Clear hierarchy. Save and pin-worthy.

meta.creative_rules: Educational value post. Clean data visualization. Shareable insight.

tiktok.creative_rules: Quick educational card. Bold numbered tips. Fast-paced learning.

youtube.creative_rules: Data visualization. Educational thumbnail. Process diagram.

beauty_skincare.master_prompt: Design a clean educational infographic about {{ .Title }}. Clear numbered steps or sections explaining {{ .Description }}. Bold title headline at top. Minimal vector icons for each point. Consistent color scheme. Clean sans-serif typography. Professional infographic quality. This is an EDUCATIONAL visual that teaches, not sells.
beauty_skincare.video_prompt: Educational video about {{ .Title }}. Step-by-step explainer with text overlays. Clean visuals. Each point numbered. {{ .Description }}.
beauty_skincare.carousel_prompt: Educational carousel about {{ .Title }}. Slide 1: Bold topic headline. Slide 2-5: One key point per slide with icon and explanation. Last slide: Summary or save prompt. {{ .Description }}. Clean consistent design.
caption_templates: Everything you need to know about {{ .Title }} 📚 {{ .Description }}

platform_adaptation.instagram: Save-worthy tip card. Clean numbered design.

beauty_skincare.product_rule: pure education, no product selling, infographic quality

general.master_prompt: Design a professional educational infographic about {{ .Title }}. Clean structured layout with clear hierarchy. Bold headline at top. Numbered sections or steps explaining {{ .Description }}. Minimal vector icons beside each point. Clean consistent color palette. Professional sans-serif typography. Clear data visualization. This must be EDUCATIONAL — teaching information clearly. Think premium educational content like Harvard Business Review or National Geographic infographic quality.
general.video_prompt: Educational explainer for {{ .Title }}. Structured step-by-step format. Clean text animations. Data visualization. {{ .Description }}.
general.carousel_prompt: Educational deep-dive carousel about {{ .Title }}. Slide 1: Compelling topic headline. Slide 2-6: One insight per slide with supporting visual. Last slide: Key takeaway summary. {{ .Description }}. Consistent clean design.
caption_templates: Save this — you'll reference it later 📌 {{ .Title }}
general.product_rule: pure education and information, clear hierarchy, no selling
